responsibility: This file lowers Fortran OpenMP and OpenACC constructs into GCC tree representations, with Fortran-specific handling for descriptors, optional arguments, allocatable/pointer semantics, and directive metadata. Beyond translating executable directives and clauses, it implements helpers used by OpenMP lowering to inspect Fortran array data and sizes, present-status checks, and declaration attributes, and it emits procedure annotations for features such as declare simd and declare variant by converting parsed/resolved Fortran OpenMP namespace data into GCC OpenMP attributes and construct trees.
